install_jepa_package: run python setup.py install to install the JEPA research code package
get_requirements: call get_requirements to read and return the contents of requirements.txt as a list
review_setup_py: review the setup.py to understand the JEPA package name, version, and dependencies
summarize_setup_py: summarize the setup.py configuration including python_requires and install_requires
refactor_get_requirements: refactor get_requirements to parse requirements.txt and strip whitespace from each line
